verdict.rationale: Alloy is a SaaS identity and fraud-decisioning platform, so bulk data export and portability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no bulk export, open-format download, or offboarding capability. Events API, webhooks and evaluation responses are per-request integration features, not a full data export, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
